evidence.docstring: It isn't a field when the value is a lambda, a call to one of v1's ignored types

problem: Says that under v1 a public attribute without an annotation (`x = 1`) is a field, unconditionally. The code excludes several values on that path: a lambda, a call to one of v1's ignored types (property and the like), and a name that resolves to a class or function are not fields.
replacement: Under v1, a public attribute without an annotation (`x = 1`) is a field unless its value is a lambda, a call to one of the types v1 ignores (such as `property`), or a name for a class or function.
route_reason: The examples run against a single pydantic-2 model, so no executed example can show v1 classification without a new fixture project; the exclusion rule has no fact extractor.

evidence.docstring: Extract Config class or model_config from a model.

problem: Says a model's configuration is reported only when its `model_config` can be read in full. That is right except on the v1 path: a nested `class Config:` is also read, and its settings are always reported (only plain-name assignments are collected, others are skipped), so it can be shown partial rather than left out.
replacement: Add after the paragraph: "A v1 nested `class Config:` is read too; its plain `name = value` assignments are reported as its settings."
route_reason: The example project's one model has no v1 `class Config`, so no executed example can show this path; no fact extractor covers configuration reading.
